metadata.latest_updates: July 2026: Verified Solidity 0.8.36 as current stable; confirmed Fusaka/PeerDAS mainnet activation (Dec 2025) and Firedancer mainnet rollout status; added US GENIUS Act (signed Jul 2025, rulemaking due Jul 2026) and CLARITY Act (House-passed, Senate pending) regulatory sources; corrected MiCA CASP grandfathering deadline (EU-wide backstop 1 Jul 2026, not already expired); corrected UK FCA citations to the Jun 2026 policy statement package. Prior: March 2026 additions retained below.
metadata.title: Software Crypto Web3 - Sources
